answer: In robotic economies surveying a glacier, physical docking attestation restricts Sybil attacks. Each agent periodically couples with a fixed lantern outpost over galvanic contacts to renew signed identity tokens. Adversaries incur unavoidable hardware costs per identity because spoofing requires manufacturing distinct physical chassis to occupy scarce berths, preventing a runaway spiral of fake nodes. However, dock congestion and contact oxidation frequently delay legitimate agents.
